## S01
SYNTHETIC prior accepted decision: the steward always chooses the next work after an attempt ends. Reason: one owner is easier to understand and holds responsibility across records.

## S02
SYNTHETIC history: an operator-approved orchestrator replacement exception was considered because the orchestrator already held the failure context and a relay could be wasteful. It was withdrawn in favor of the single-owner steward rule. This source records the earlier debate, not a current permission.

## S03
SYNTHETIC prior context: execution recovery, durable intentions, completion wakeups, desk ownership and start-versus-drive are accepted as individually listed. Whether stopping always requires consultation remains open. Arbitrary cancellation policy remains open.
